item.title: Traefik Local Auth Proxy
item.description: If you need to access an HTTP service that requires authentication (Bearer or Basic auth), but you don’t want to put the API token anywhere near your code, you can use this script to create a localhost-only proxy for that service. The proxy accepts unauthenticated requests originating only from 127.0.0.1, and it will inject the API token into your requests, and forward them to the upstream server. This kind of thing might also be useful for integration with third party software that doesn’t support authentication.
